caption: Training curves on the synthetic dataset. We refer our readers to Figure <ref> in Appendix <ref> for a visualization of the synthetic dataset.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the training accuracy over time, as measured by epochs, for three different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Epoch" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with numeric tick marks every 50 units. The y-axis is labeled "Training Accuracy" and also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The first line, represented in light purple with a solid line style, shows data labeled as "C³A_b=128/2." This line starts at a training accuracy of 0.1 at epoch 0, increases sharply, and eventually stabilizes at around 1.0 after epoch 100. The second line, shown in light gray and labeled "LoRA_T=1," begins with fluctuations, initially at 0.1 accuracy at epoch 0, then steadily increases with some variability, reaching approximately 1.0 in the final epochs. Finally, the third line, in light blue with a solid line style and labeled "Linear," starts at 0.0 training accuracy, exhibits fluctuations, then gradually increases, reaching approximately 1 by epoch 60, although it experiences some declines and further rises towards the end. A legend is provided on the bottom right to map different line colors to labels.
